data.name: Samraht
data.long_meaning: Samraht is derived from the Arabic root 'S-M-R' which means protection and guardianship. This name is a powerful reminder of Allah's protection and guidance.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the guardianship and protection of Allah Almighty.
data.numerology_meaning: Indicates new beginnings, leadership, and the ability to accomplish great things.

in_arabic.name: سمراة
in_arabic.meaning: جمال و حسن، رونق و خوبی
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق از 'سمرة' به معنی درختی که همیشه سبز است، نمادی از جمال و ثبات، وصفتی برای کسی که دارای چهره ای زیبا و اخلاقی نیکوست، ریشه در فرهنگ عربی و اشاره به مفاهیم زیبایی و پایداری در قرآن و سنت اسلامی

in_urdu.name: سمرہت
in_urdu.meaning: خوبی اور جمال، رونق اور حسن
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہوا، 'سمرة' سے مشتق جو ایک ہمیشہ سبز رہنے والے درخت کا نام ہے، اسلامی ثقافت میں حسن اور جمال کی علامت، جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان روایتی استعمال، خوبصورتی اور اچھائی کی صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: समराहट
in_hindi.meaning: सुंदरता और अच्छाई, चेहरे की सुंदरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: इस्लामी नामकरण परंपरा में जड़ें, 'समराहट' सुंदरता और नैतिक अच्छाई का प्रतीक, भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उपयोग, आध्यात्मिक महत्व और सांस्कृतिक प्रसंग

in_pashto.name: سمرهت
in_pashto.long_meaning: د پښتو کلتور او اسلامي دود څخه، د 'سمرة' څخه اخیستل شوی چې معنی یې دایمي شنه پاتې کیدونکي ونې دي، د افغان او پښتون دودونو کې د ښکلا او اخلاقو د ښه والي نښه

in_english.name: Samraht
in_english.meaning: Beauty and goodness, a symbol of moral excellence
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from Arabic root 'سمرة' (samara), meaning a tree that remains green, symbolizing eternal beauty and moral integrity, referenced in Islamic tradition for its connotations of goodness and righteousness, used across Muslim cultures

pronunciation.urdu: سم رحت کے طور پر تلفظ

data.cultural_impact: Samraht may not have a widely recognized cultural significance as it is not a commonly used name in the Islamic world. However, the concept of protection and guardianship is a significant theme in Islamic culture as it is emphasized in various Quranic verses and Hadiths. For example, Allah says in the Quran, "And He it is Who has made you successors [on the earth] after them, generously provisioning [you] therein; so check one another [in righteousness] and listen and your Lord [to you]" (Al-Baqarah 2:30). This verse shows the sense of responsibility and protection that Muslims have towards each other and their surroundings.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Samraht is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings, as it serves as a reminder of Allah's protection and guidance in one's life. Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Allah will not leave this [Islam] until His protection is better than [your] protections, and His security is better than your security, and His help is better than your help" (Bukhari 4031). By embracing the name Samraht, one is constantly reminded of the ultimate Protector and Guardian, Allah, and the need to rely on His guidance and protection in all aspects of life.
